notes.title: The Gold Maker : Rendez-Vous With Death by StudioTraexid
notes.notes:
We are proud to announce our upcoming game [b]The Gold Maker : Rendez-vous with Death ![/b] 

Marioles took a deep breath during the holidays and now we are ready for the final stretch of development :') 

We will try to post regular content about the universe of the game and development status here on Steam and on our social media platforms.

Get excited for our story of Love, of War, of Life and Death !
